sun.window_note: One lunar daytime, from shortly after sunrise (Sun 1.5 deg up) to shortly before sunset: 178 deg of the 181.3 deg of hour angle between flat-horizon sunrise and sunset (14.6 of the 14.9 Earth days of daylight). The other half of the 29.53-day cycle is night (shaded on the graph).

array.assumption: Illustrative engineering shape, not a real design: short mast, hub 2.4 m above ground; two wings of 3 hinged panels, each panel 2.0 m x 1.2 m (total 14.4 m2), that unfold upwards and end flat (horizontal, tilt 0 deg), as the mission's irradiance (a horizontal surface) assumes. No tracking.

panel_text.graph_caption: Power per m², one lunar cycle (0–1,400)
panel_text.model_tag: Model: S0 1361 W/m² × sin(Sun elev.) × visible disc, flat panel, before cell efficiency. Lunar day: 29.5 Earth days, about half of it night.

render.lighting_note: Sun: one parallel light of fixed intensity (3.2 in renderer units, chosen so that the high noon Sun does not saturate the light-grey ground); terrain shadows from the real SLDEM2015 horizons; 3.5 % uniform fill (assumption). Display exposure (a camera setting; the light and the power are not changed): min(8, max(1, sin 25° / sin h)), h = Sun elevation; stated on screen whenever it is above 1.25.

rows.label: Sunlight above the atmosphere
rows.earth_note: top of the atmosphere, formula from latitude

card.legend_head: Sunlight above the atmosphere: on Earth, the annual-mean daily sunlight on a horizontal surface at the top of the atmosphere, from the cell's latitude (a formula); on the Moon, the table's surface irradiance (horizontal, S0 = 1361 W/m², averaged over the whole lunar cycle, nights included). Sunlight reaching the ground on Earth: WorldClim 2.1, modelled (non-commercial licence). A panel at the Earth site receives only the sunlight that reaches the ground.

captions.cue_rule: Cue boundaries are the frames where the panel status changes (render.js --timeline), plus mid-phase cues and the closing card; render.js refuses to write captions if the status changes inside a cue.

en.header: Solar panels mission video (3D simulation), English descriptive captions
en.note: No speech. Each cue gives the values on the on-screen panel at its start time; the panel status does not change within a cue. The Sun is computed; power and energy are a stated model for a flat (horizontal) panel per m², before any cell efficiency; array size and timing are illustrative. While the Sun is low the display exposure is raised (not to scale).

es.header: Vídeo de la misión de paneles solares (simulación 3D), subtítulos descriptivos en español
es.note: Sin voz. Cada subtítulo da los valores del panel en pantalla al inicio del subtítulo; el estado del panel no cambia dentro de un subtítulo. El Sol es calculado; potencia y energía son un modelo declarado para un panel plano (horizontal) por m², antes de la eficiencia de las células; el tamaño de los paneles y los tiempos son ilustrativos. Mientras el Sol está bajo se aumenta la exposición de la imagen (no a escala).
